text:
anya: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 is ready for merge; only things left are a gofumpt diff and one lint nit. Planning to merge in the off-peak window today at 18:00 PST unless someone objects. Tests had a flaky e2e that I retried and it passed, but noting it below.
chris: Can you paste the gofumpt diff? If it's just formatting I'm fine with a fast-forward merge. What's the flaky test id?
anya: Sure — running `gofumpt` changed imports order and one multi-line struct alignment. Command I ran:
```sh
gofumpt -w ./...
``` 
Example diff (short):
```diff
- type Config struct { Host string `json:"host"` }
+ type Config struct {
+     Host string `json:"host"`
+ }
```
Flaky test: `TestKVStoreReconnect` — failing ~1/200 runs; retried and green. Filed infra issue #345 for follow-up.
marie: I had a tiny nit on a variable name in the helper but it's non-blocking, can fix post-merge if you want to avoid timeout on the release window. :+1:
sam: LGTM from me. I can take the second approval if @koji is out; otherwise queue for koji. I'll hold the merge until 18:00 as planned. :thumbsup:
lgtm-bot: Approved by @sam
deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #4821 entered merge queue (base branch protected: 2 approvals required). Current approvals: 1/2.
koji: grabbing this now. If marie's nit is non-blocking then go ahead. I'll do a quick scan for any risky changes. :eyes:
koji: LGTM — small formatting only, no behavior changes. :shipit:
anya: Thanks all. Merging now (18:02 PST). I'll watch CI and post a follow-up if anything flaps. If anyone wants the var-name nit tracked, I'll open a tiny follow-up PR today.
chris: Thanks — appreciate the heads-up. :thumbsup:
